comparison.objective: Stow a rack console drawer into a rack, versus tune and lock a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rail alignment, constrained sliding insertion, and possible latch engagement versus fine tool seating, collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Fully seated drawer stowage is title-implied; no body/specs, rail tolerance, latch, or cable-safety rubric is present. Candidate requires two validated physical stops and no adjustment drift.
comparison.reason: Rack-drawer insertion tests rail alignment and translation, not iterative dynamic calibration.
